race.comment: TREMONT (3) makes strong appeal on debut with a solid trial base, most recently winning at Flemington, and the Ben, Will & JD Hayes stable has the right profile to have him ready first time out. His pedigree adds further substance, being a half-brother to Group 3 winner Zilong, so he looks up to this moderate affair despite lacking race experience. SHE'S LOADED (6) is the best exposed form runner, with consecutive seconds at Kilmore and Cranbourne and three placings from three tries around 1300m. Go close again. GAMADALE PADDY (11) resumed with a good second at Mildura after beginning awkwardly and has more upside than most raced runners. THE PALLET MAN (12) didn't fire on debut in a deeper maiden at Bendigo but can improve sharply this time in.
